name: Norfolk
operatingHours: The Tide light rail runs ~6:00 AM–10:00 PM Mon–Thu, ~6:00 AM–12:00 AM Fri–Sat and ~7:00 AM–9:00 PM Sun (holidays ~9:00 AM–9:00 PM), every ~15 min (~10 min at peak, ~30 min early and late). No overnight service.
fareInfo: $2.00 per ride on The Tide, HRT buses and the Elizabeth River Ferry (2026). Tap a contactless bank card, phone or GoMobile card (or use the GoMobile app) before boarding: fares cap at $4.50 a day (third ride $0.50, then free) and $70 a month. Ticket machines on Tide platforms also sell fares; cash paid on board does not count toward the cap.

sights.name: Battleship Wisconsin at Nauticus
sights.note: One of the last and largest battleships the US Navy built, moored beside Nauticus with open decks, turrets and below-deck spaces to explore.
sights.hours: Tue–Sun 10:00 AM–5:00 PM (with Nauticus admission); closed Mon

sights.name: Chrysler Museum of Art
sights.note: A wide-ranging free art museum on the edge of Ghent, best known for its glass collection and the Perry Glass Studio's daily noon glassblowing demos.
sights.hours: Tue–Sat 10:00 AM–5:00 PM, Sun 12:00–5:00 PM; closed Mon; free

sights.name: Nauticus
sights.note: A waterfront maritime science center with hands-on exhibits on ships, the sea and the Navy, plus the free Hampton Roads Naval Museum upstairs.

sights.name: Norfolk Botanical Garden
sights.note: A 175-acre garden beside the airport with themed plantings, azalea woods, a conservatory and boat or tram tours along the canals.
sights.hours: Daily 9:00 AM–5:00 PM (conservatory 10:00 AM–5:00 PM, closed Tue)

sights.name: Virginia Zoo
sights.note: A mid-sized zoo next to Lafayette Park with an African savanna, Asian forest and an orangutan habitat, easy for a half-day with kids.

sights.name: MacArthur Memorial
sights.note: General Douglas MacArthur's tomb and museum in Norfolk's 1850 domed former city hall, tracing his career from West Point to Korea.

sights.name: Hermitage Museum and Gardens
sights.note: An Arts and Crafts mansion on the Lafayette River holding an eclectic art collection, set in waterside gardens and woodland.
sights.hours: Tue–Sun 10:00 AM–5:00 PM (from mid-Oct ~4:30 PM Fri–Sun); free

sights.name: Wells Theatre
sights.note: A lavishly restored 1913 Beaux-Arts playhouse that is now home to the Virginia Stage Company.
sights.hours: Open for performances; see the season schedule

sights.name: Slover Library
sights.note: Norfolk's striking main library, joining a restored 1900s customs building to a glass-walled modern wing with history exhibits and maker spaces.
sights.hours: Mon 10:00 AM–6:00 PM, Tue–Thu 9:00 AM–7:00 PM, Fri–Sat 9:00 AM–5:00 PM; closed Sun

sights.name: Pagoda & Oriental Garden
sights.note: A small free harborside garden with koi ponds and a pagoda gifted by Taiwan, a quiet spot for sunset over the Elizabeth River.

sights.name: Harbor Park
sights.note: The riverside home of the Norfolk Tides, the Orioles' Triple-A team, with skyline views and a Tide stop at the gate.

sights.name: Town Point Park
sights.note: A downtown riverfront lawn and promenade that hosts Norfolk's festivals and gives open views of shipping on the Elizabeth River.
sights.hours: Open daily, dawn to late evening

sights.name: Moses Myers House
sights.note: A Federal-style townhouse from 1792 kept with much of its original furniture, showing the life of one of Norfolk's first Jewish families.
sights.hours: Sat–Sun 12:00–5:00 PM, or by appointment; free

sights.name: Elizabeth River Ferry
sights.note: A paddle-wheel-style passenger ferry from Waterside to Old Town Portsmouth, the cheapest harbor cruise in town at the regular bus fare.
sights.hours: Winter: Mon–Thu ~5:30 AM–9:45 PM, Fri to ~11:45 PM, Sat ~10:00 AM–11:45 PM, Sun ~10:00 AM–9:45 PM; every 30 min

sights.name: Virginia Beach Boardwalk
sights.note: A 3-mile oceanfront promenade about 30 km east with a wide sand beach and the giant King Neptune statue; not on the Tide, reached by car or HRT bus.

railStations.name: Norfolk Amtrak Station
railStations.note: Terminus of an Amtrak Northeast Regional branch to Richmond, Washington, New York and Boston (~3 round trips weekdays, ~2 on weekends). The Harbor Park Tide stop is a short walk west.
railStations.hours: Waiting room opens around train times (~5:00 AM–~10:30 PM); trains run to timetable.

airports.name: Norfolk International Airport
airports.transitNote: Not on the Tide and no direct HRT bus (nearest is Route 15, ~2.4 km away). Take a taxi or Uber/Lyft to downtown, ~13 km and ~20 min. Virginia Beach's oceanfront is ~25 min by car.
airports.hours: No rail link; taxis and rideshare serve all flights.
